title: Wadventurous Pilaf Bake
description: This wadventurous pilaf bake combines the flavors of pilaf with the surprise of gooey cheese and a crispy biscuit crust. Perfect for those who like a little excitement in their meal.
instructions: Cook pilaf according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add crushed biscuit to the pan and cook until golden brown.
Stir in dried herbs, salt, and pepper.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the pilaf mixture.
Top with half of the biscuit mixture and half of the cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
